sources.title: ‘Pluribus’ Promotes Samba Schutte to Series Regular for Season 2
‘Pluribus’ Ups Samba Schutte to Series Regular in Season 2

en.title: Pluribus promotes Samba Schutte to series regular for Season 2
en.dek: Samba Schutte promoted to series regular for Pluribus Season 2
facts: Samba Schutte has been upped to series regular status for Pluribus Season 2
Schutte played Mr. Diabate in Season 1 as a guest star
The series earned 18 Emmy nominations for its first season, winning six including lead actress and writing
Schutte previously starred in HBO Max's Our Flag Means Death and NBC's Sunnyside
Schutte earned a Saturn Award nomination for best guest star for Season 1 work
body: Variety reported that Samba Schutte has been upped to series regular status for Pluribus Season 2. Schutte is known for playing Mr. Diabate in Season 1 as a guest star.

The Hollywood Reporter noted that Schutte, who appeared in two episodes of the Emmy-winning Apple TV series' first season, will be a series regular in the coming season. Pluribus is in production on season two, though Apple TV has yet to announce a premiere date.
Schutte's character Mr. Diabate is immune to the outbreak and lives a hedonistic lifestyle, like lead character Carol Sturka played by Rhea Seehorn.
Schutte's previous credits include HBO Max's Our Flag Means Death, NBC's Sunnyside, and voice work on Jurassic World: Chaos Theory and several Call of Duty: Black Ops games.
Schutte was a writer and correspondent on the Dutch version of The Daily Show.
en.context: Pluribus is an Apple TV series that debuted in November 2025. It earned 18 total Emmy nominations for its first season, winning six including lead actress honors for Rhea Seehorn and a writing win for creator Vince Gilligan.

El personaje de Schutte, el Sr. Diabate, es inmune al brote y lleva un estilo de vida hedonista, como el personaje principal Carol Sturka, interpretado por Rhea Seehorn.

body: Variety ha riportato che Samba Schutte è stato promosso a regular di serie per la Stagione 2 di Pluribus. Schutte è noto per aver interpretato il signor Diabate nella Stagione 1 come guest star.

The Hollywood Reporter ha osservato che Schutte, che ha partecipato a due episodi della serie Apple TV vincitrice di un Emmy nella prima stagione, sarà un regular di serie nella stagione prossima. Pluribus è in produzione sulla stagione due, sebbene Apple TV non abbia ancora annunciato una data di uscita.
Il personaggio di Schutte, il signor Diabate, è immune all'epidemia e conduce uno stile di vita hedonistico, come il personaggio principale Carol Sturka, interpretato da Rhea Seehorn.
I precedenti crediti di Schutte includono Our Flag Means Death di HBO Max, Sunnyside di NBC e il lavoro vocale su Jurassic World: Chaos Theory e diversi giochi di Call of Duty: Black Ops.
Schutte è stato writer e correspondent nella versione olandese di The Daily Show.

pt.title: Pluribus promove Samba Schutte a ator regular da segunda temporada
pt.dek: Samba Schutte é promovido a ator regular em Pluribus Temporada 2

A série recebeu 18 nomeações ao Emmy na sua primeira temporada, ganhando seis, incluindo atriz principal e escrita

body: A Variety reportou que Samba Schutte foi promovido a ator regular na segunda temporada de Pluribus. Schutte é conhecido por interpretar o Sr. Diabate na primeira temporada como convidado.

O Hollywood Reporter notou que Schutte, que apareceu em dois episódios da primeira temporada da série da Apple TV vencedora do Emmy, será ator regular na próxima temporada. Pluribus está em produção para a segunda temporada, embora a Apple TV ainda não tenha anunciado uma data de estreia.
O personagem de Schutte, Sr. Diabate, é imune ao surto e leva um estilo de vida hedonista, tal como a personagem principal Carol Sturka, interpretada por Rhea Seehorn.
Os créditos anteriores de Schutte incluem Our Flag Means Death da HBO Max, Sunnyside da NBC e trabalho de voz em Jurassic World: Chaos Theory e vários jogos de Call of Duty: Black Ops.
Schutte foi escritor e correspondente na versão holandesa do The Daily Show.
pt.context: Pluribus é uma série da Apple TV que estreou em novembro de 2025. Recebeu um total de 18 nomeações ao Emmy na sua primeira temporada, ganhando seis, incluindo o prémio de atriz principal para Rhea Seehorn e um prémio de escrita para o criador Vince Gilligan.

zh.title: Pluribus 提拔 Samba Schutte 为第二季常驻演员
zh.dek: Samba Schutte 晋升 Pluribus 第二季常驻演员
facts: Samba Schutte 晋升 Pluribus 第二季常驻演员
Schutte 在第一季中客串饰演 Mr. Diabate
该剧首季获得 18 次艾美奖提名，其中包括主演女演员和编剧奖共六项
Schutte 此前出演过 HBO Max 的《我们的旗帜意味着死亡》和 NBC 的《Sunnyside》
Schutte 因第一季作品获得土星奖最佳客串奖提名
body: Variety 报道，Samba Schutte 已被提拔为《Pluribus》第二季常驻演员。Schutte 在第一季以客串身份饰演 Diabate 一角。
《好莱坞报道者》指出，Schutte 曾在获奖的 Apple TV+ 系列剧第一季中出演两集，将在即将播出的季数中成为常驻演员。《Pluribus》正在第二季制作中，但 Apple TV+ 尚未宣布首播日期。
Schutte 饰演的 Diabate 角色对该病毒具有免疫力，过着放纵的生活方式，这与由 Rhea Seehorn 饰演的主角 Carol Sturka 相似。
Schutte 的过往作品包括 HBO Max 的《我们的旗帜意味着死亡》、NBC 的《Sunnyside》，以及《侏罗纪世界：混乱理论》和多部《使命召唤：黑色行动》游戏的配音工作。
Schutte 曾是荷兰版《每日秀》的作家和通讯员。
zh.context: 《Pluribus》是苹果电视的一部剧集，于 2025 年 11 月首播。该剧首季共获得 18 次艾美奖提名，其中包括瑞亚·西霍恩（Rhea Seehorn）的首席女演员奖和创作者文斯·吉利根（Vince Gilligan）的编剧奖等六项。
zh.imageCaption: Samba Schutte 在《Pluribus》中亮相（苹果电视+）

ja.title: プルービバス、シーズン2でサムバ・シュットをレギュラー俳優に昇格させる
ja.dek: プルービバス シーズン2、サムバ・シュットをシリーズ常連に昇格
facts: サムバ・シュットがプルービバス シーズン2でシリーズ常連に昇格
シーズン1でディアバテ役をゲスト出演
同シーズンはエミー賞18部門にノミネートされ、主演女優賞と脚本賞など6部門を受賞
シュットは以前、HBO Maxの『Our Flag Means Death』とNBCの『Sunnyside』に出演
シーズン1の功績でサターン賞最優秀ゲスト賞にノミネートされた
body: バラエティ紙は、サムバ・シュットが『プルービバス』シーズン2でレギュラー俳優に昇格したと報じた。シュットはシーズン1でゲスト出演としてディアバテ氏を演じたことで知られている。
ハリウッド・レポーターは、エミー賞受賞作であるApple TVシリーズのシーズン1に2話で出演したシュットが、次シーズンからはレギュラーとなることを指摘した。『プルービバス』のシーズン2は制作中だが、Apple TVからはまだプレミア公開日は発表されていない。
シュットが演じるディアバテ氏は、発生したアウトブレイクの影響を受けず、主演のキャロル・スターカ（リア・シーホーンが演じる）と同様に享楽的な生活を送っている。
シュットのこれまでの出演作には、HBO Maxの『アワー・フラッグ・ミーンズ・デス』、NBCの『サンナイサイド』、そして『ジュラシック・ワールド：カオス・セオリー』や複数の『コール オブ デューティ：ブラック オプス』ゲームでの声優業が含まれる。
シュットは、オランダ版の『ザ・デイリー・ショー』でライターおよび特派員を務めていた。
ja.context: プルービバスは2025年11月に配信開始されたApple TV+シリーズ。1シーズン目でエミー賞18部門にノミネートされ、主演女優賞はリア・シーホーン、脚本賞はヴィンス・ギルギガンが受賞した。
ja.imageCaption: Apple TV+『プルービバス』に出演するサムバ・シュット

problemsFixed: Body paragraph 2 contains an unsupported claim about Mr. Diabate's lifestyle that is not in the sources. The sources only state he is immune to the outbreak and lives a hedonistic lifestyle (Variety) or enjoys the new status quo (THR), but do not specify a Las Vegas casino hotel or 'every whim catered to'.
Body paragraph 3 contains an unsupported claim about a Saturn Award nomination that is not in the provided Variety source (though present in THR).
The dek references Variety but the body also cites The Hollywood Reporter; attribution must be consistent.
The opening paragraph repeats the promotion fact from the dek, violating the rule against restating.
The context paragraph includes the vague phrase 'well-received by critics and audiences' without a sourced number; the sources give the specific number 18 Emmy nominations.
The body ends with an evaluative summary sentence ('It was one of the most nominated series...').
The headline is 55 characters and acceptable, but the dek needs tightening to avoid referencing a specific outlet in a way that creates attribution conflict.
